description: Versioned evaluation corpus. expected/<name>.json is hand-audited truth for the fixture in corpus/<name>; known_missing/known_extra record the engine's current deltas so regressions fail and fixes must retire entries. Fixtures with before/ and after/ subdirectories are controlled changes — each state is indexed and compared independently (renames, deletions, removed exports, base-only code).

fixtures.name: py-alias
fixtures.covers: import-alias resolution (from X import Y as Z)

fixtures.name: py-alias-shadow
fixtures.covers: alias named like another project function; same imported name in two modules

fixtures.name: py-alias-dotted
fixtures.covers: aliases from a dotted module (pkg.mod) and a relative module (.mod)

fixtures.name: mono-mixed
fixtures.covers: monorepo layout, vendored dir, generated file

fixtures.name: py-rename
fixtures.covers: file rename keeping symbol and re-attaching the cross-file edge

fixtures.name: py-delete
fixtures.covers: function deleted from a surviving file; stale edge and symbol must vanish

fixtures.name: py-export-removed
fixtures.covers: package re-export removed; stale edge is a recorded precision miss

fixtures.name: ts-crossfile
fixtures.covers: named ES import and cross-file call resolution

fixtures.name: py-real-slice
fixtures.covers: real repository code (pallets/itsdangerous exc+encoding+signer, BSD-3-Clause) with real cross-file calls
